snippet.title: Trailer Gameplay 2 | The Magic Master
snippet.description:
A soulslike inspired game with a magic-only, long-range combat system. Defeat unique bosses along a linear path and unlock new spells.

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bercamilan.TheMagicMaster
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4819250/The_Magic_Master/
